C0 conditional self-damage actions only; all stated hits must actually connect and all stated stats/target conditions must hold.

Aloy was not promoted: pinned gcsim accepts an arbitrary bomblets count (default 2), does not establish a four-bomblet complete cast, and explicitly marks main snapshot timing TODO. Existing single-hit mappings remain usable.

KQM provides an independent documented eight-mine observation for Klee; this is not a new measurement by this project. KQM and gcsim third-bounce frame values differ (145 vs 140); the conditional total uses stable damage context and does not certify precise frame timings.

Chevreuse A1 is now accounted per hit from an explicit prior target debuff and party eligibility; no automatic Overload timing. Overcharged A4 must actually be active before its own damage snapshots when unlocked.
Neuvillette A4 must be included from the actual stable HP ratio; no default full-HP assumption or inferred dynamic HP.
Arkhe readiness is a named precondition. Opposite-alignment annihilation, automatic reactions/ICD, target geometry, particle/energy and rotation validation remain separate.

neededActualInputs: amount already included in the supplied Hydro damage bonus
neuvilletteA4.application: Apply actual A4 minus explicitly included share through the typed AST. Each hit can restore its actual HP ratio; a shared ratio is available only under an explicit stable-context declaration. Historical hits require own inputs.
neuvilletteA4.timing: Waterfall MaxHP scalar at cast, damage stats snapshot at 23f; thorn snapshot at 60f. A4 Extra:true does not bypass Stats() snapshot. Source snapshot-delay TODO remains.

chevreuseA4.formula: attackPercent = ascension >= 4 && actualBuffActive ? min(actualMaxHpAtOverchargedShot/100000,0.40) : 0; flatAttackContribution = actorBaseAttack * attackPercent
neededActualInputs: actual buff active at each snapshot
actual Chevreuse MaxHP when the relevant Overcharged Ball was fired
attack contribution already included in supplied final ATK
chevreuseA4.application: Apply actual percentage minus explicitly included percentage, then multiply corresponding base ATK through the typed AST; exact equal shares require no unknown base. Ordinary press/hold and Q may only inherit a prior active buff.
chevreuseA4.timing: New Overcharged Ball buff applies at hold+13f, six frames before main damage snapshot at hold+19f; blade snapshot at hold+55f. Lasts 30s with hitlag extension. This branch requires stable final stats at both snapshots.

neededActualInputs: actual party has only Pyro/Electro and at least one of each
actual target debuff active at each hit
resistance reduction already included in input target resistance/reduction
chevreuseA1.application: Apply actual reduction minus explicitly included reduction through the typed AST for each hit. Do not infer an earlier debuff from the current hit being selected to Overload. A pre-finalized effectiveResistance with a nonzero remaining difference is blocked until its accounting is restored.
chevreuseA1.timing: Debuff starts only from actual Overload-damage OnEnemyDamage on that enemy; lasts 6s with hitlag extension. The hit preceding the first Overload damage cannot automatically receive this new debuff. This branch requires the resistance state to hold for all hits or be absent for all hits.

productionAccounting.unknownPolicy: Missing actual states or included shares block only their dependent selected hits. No default full HP, inactive buff or zero included share. Fresh-equipment construction alone can establish a new offensive panel has zero prior source share.
productionAccounting.historicalPolicy: Historical finalSnapshot hits require own hit state and own base ATK. Normal hits use equipment-derived base ATK, otherwise explicit shared base ATK. Exact zero ATK percentage difference requires no unknown base ATK.
productionAccounting.resetPolicy: Replacing offensive panels preserves historical hit state and enemy A1 resistance accounting. Imported final offensive panels require newly explicit included shares.
productionAccounting.validation: No tests, build or generator executed for this increment.
productionAccounting.materializationApi: finalizeBatchProjectilePanelAccounting(document): void; called only after successful core final-resistance materialization. Updates known nonhistorical Chevreuse hits to the actual A1 share and rebuilds their zero-difference formula; never called for ordinary character-panel import.
productionAccounting.emptyContainers: prepare creates sharedState={} and hitStates[id]={}; all actual values remain absent/unknown.
